a:r.a:t: Let me be specific about compatibility. Rift implements every predicate type that Mountebank supports.
You can use equals for exact matching, deepEquals for object comparison, contains for substring matching. All the string operators work: startsWith, endsWith, matches for regex.
The advanced query languages work too: JSONPath for matching JSON request bodies, XPath for XML. You can combine predicates with and, or, and not.
For responses, static 'is' responses work, proxy mode works for forwarding to real backends, and inject works for JavaScript-based dynamic responses.
All the behaviors are there: wait for latency, decorate for response transformation, copy for extracting request values into responses, lookup for pulling data from CSV files.
Rift has 126 compatibility test scenarios that run against both Mountebank and Rift to verify byte-for-byte identical responses.
